title: User Facing Ui Label Cleanup
description: Clean UI labels to user perspective: engagement options → Commands/toggles, no state machine lingo in user space.
summary: Fixed Search/Find navbar inconsistency: sketchpad resolver no longer maps both toggles to search.open (find uses find.open + new i18n). Find toggle uses TextSearch icon vs Search magnifying glass. Aligned de copy (Finden vs Suche). UISearch/UIFind dialogs use ui.search.* / ui.find.* i18n. Tests: 108 @semio-tech/ui-react.
